The Fiend.description: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, seeking destruction or dark secrets.

1.name: Dark One's Blessing
1.tldr: Gain temporary hit points whenever you reduce an enemy creature to 0 hit points.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.tldr: Call on your patron to add a bonus to an ability check or saving throw.

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.tldr: Choose a damage type and gain resistance to it until you change it during a rest.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.tldr: Temporarily banish a creature through the lower planes, dealing psychic damage when it returns.

The Archfey.description: Your pact is with a lord or lady of the fey, filled with unpredictable charm, illusions, and nature magic.

1.name: Fey Presence
1.tldr: Project a dazzling or terrifying magical presence that charms or frightens nearby creatures.

6.name: Misty Escape
6.tldr: Disappear into a puff of mist and teleport away invisibly when you take damage.

10.name: Beguiling Defenses
10.tldr: Become immune to being charmed, and reflect charm attempts back at the attacker.

14.name: Dark Delirium
14.tldr: Plunge a creature into an illusory realm of fey magic, incapacitating it with fear or charm.
